The following events took place in '''10 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Desiccation of Gholondreine-β]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] first visited the [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi system]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon (novel)">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] escaped the [[Liberator (Liberator-class)|''Trader's Luck'']] and was hired as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] by the [[Cult of The One and The All]] on [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]].<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>
*Han Solo fled Ylesia with [[Bria Tharen]], [[Muuurgh]] and [[Mrrov]].<ref name="TPS" />
*[[Wedding of Muuurgh and Mrrov]].<ref name="TPS" />
*The [[Reslian Purge]] begins as expansionist [[Lortan]] fanatics sweep across twelve [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], destroying everything in their path.<ref name="UAA169" />
*[[Cadet/Legends|Cadets]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] entered the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]].
*The [[Dressel system/Legends|Dressel system]] came under [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control; the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] resistance formed.
*Imperial subjugation of [[Carratos]].
*An Imperial [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] arena on [[Travnin/Legends|Travnin]] collapsed.
*High-ranking Imperial official [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] married into the [[Motti family]] of [[Phelarion/Legends|Phelarion]].
*[[Houk–Weequay conflicts|War]] broke out between the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]] and [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] on [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Secrets of Sisar Run22" />
*[[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] stopped producing [[Anxarta-class Freighter|''Anxarta''-class light freighters]].
*The [[Twilight Class]] graduated at the [[Galactic Outdoor Survival School/Legends|Galactic Outdoor Survival School]], breaking the [[Summit Class]]'s previous record.
*[[Droid/Legends|Droids]] rebelled on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
*[[Fort Nowhere]] was constructed on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="TEA" />
*[[Daric LaRone]] joined the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>
*Beginning of the [[South Cont's civil war]].<ref name="Allegiance" />
*[[Quip Fargil]] gave the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] its final name.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*[[Destruction of Paran]].<ref name="PotGVT">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref>
*[[Time of Panic]].<ref name="PotGVT" />
